target_component: uv build tar reader / sdist extraction
task_instructions: Starting in version 0.13.0 with the new tar backend, uv build rejects sdists produced by CPython tarfile when the file group name is 32 characters or longer. CPython writes a 32-byte ustar gname field without a NUL terminator and emits the full name in a PAX gname header. uv rejects this with 'invalid ustar gname field: missing NUL terminator'. Update tar header parsing to accept non-NUL-terminated 32-byte fields when overridden by PAX or when the field fills the full buffer width.
expected_behavior: uv build must successfully read and extract sdists containing 32-byte or longer group/user names produced by CPython tarfile, respecting PAX headers without raising missing NUL terminator errors.
